chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Ḥasan, from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
It is only among the أهل البيت.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, from whom the report is transmitted
key_terms.أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ: the people of the household; here indicating household inclusion in context
key_terms.الْإِسْنَادِ: the chain of narrators transmitting the hadith
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ: the narrator Samāʿah in the sanad

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith statement “إِنَّمَا هِيَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ” mean in the context of purification rulings?
ai.summary: This report states that the subject in question is regarded as being from the household. In the chapter context of waters and purification, it is used as a concise legal indicator tied to rulings of ritual purity and domestic proximity.
